subject: Graduate 2026 application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am writing about Water Technology's graduate positions for 2026, advertised at https://www.watertech.com.au/applications-now-open-graduates-interns/ (applications close 5pm ACST 29 October). I am contacting recruitment@ because that inbox is published on Water Technology job pages for applications.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge. I live in Melton Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your Melbourne Notting Hill head office and civil engineering graduate pathway match the stormwater and civil documentation work I trained in. I have not used TUFLOW or other specialist hydraulic modelling tools on a job.

Please consider me for the 2026 graduate intake. I have attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
